name: Ravemon
main_effect:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[End of Attack] By deleting this Digimon that has a digivolution card with [Bird] in any of its traits, at the end of your opponent's turn, play 1 [Ravemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] If your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, if your opponent has 7 or fewer cards in their hand, they add the top card of their security stack to their hand.
